answer_1.quote: Question generation task requires a system to produce natural language questions based on the given context... We evaluate our prompting method on the following three public datasets: WebQuestions (WQ), PathQuestions (PQ), GrailQA (GQ)...

answer_2.quote: We rely on a set of well-established metrics as for KBQG evaluation: BLEU-4, METEOR and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation by randomly sampling 300 examples from the test set of WQ dataset. ... questions are rated on a scale of 1 to 5 considering the aspects of syntactic correctness, complexity, and relevance to the given logical forms.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated question from 1 (poor) to 5 (perfect) on syntactic correctness, complexity, and relevance to the logical form.
